name: Dodla Dairy Ltd
title: Dodla Dairy Ltd - 543306 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 5% as milk procurement rose to INR41/l vs INR37.4 a year ago and prices lagged; management guides 50-100bps gross margin recovery in FY27, but adjusted FY26 PAT is only ~INR215 cr after one-offs.

capex.quote: overall standalone we are expecting around INR 130 crores of capex

triggers.label: Procurement INR37.4 → INR41/l YoY
triggers.quote: The average procurement cost in Q4 FY26 stood at INR41 per liter as against INR38.7 per liter in the previous quarter and INR37.4 per liter in Q4 FY25.

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 5%, price lag
triggers.quote: An increase in procurement price was not fully passed on to the selling price to maintain the market share.

triggers.label: FY27 gross margin +50-100bps
triggers.quote: We are expecting a gradual gross margin recovery of 50 to 100 basis points over FY26 levels as procurement normalizes and our pricing actions take effect.

triggers.label: Maharashtra capex INR180 cr in FY27
triggers.quote: balance INR180 crores we're planned to spend in FY27

guidance.quote: We expect revenue growth to be in the low to mid -teens
gradual gross margin recovery of 50 to 100 basis points over FY26 levels
an 8% to 9% organic growth in our India business
Effective tax rate will return to the normal 25 to 27 range

guidance.value: 15% to 18% of consolidated revenue by FY28
guidance.quote: We see Africa scaling towards 15% to 18% of consolidated revenue by FY28
broadly we are targeting closer to 32% to 34% in terms of VAP contribution
expected to start commercial operations by the end of FY27
Total capex budgeted for this project is currently around INR60 crores
we are confident of maintaining the 20% kind of growth numbers in the current year

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT flattered by one-offs
red_flags.quote: Excluding these two one -off items, our Q4 underlying PAT is approximately INR40 crores.

red_flags.label: Pricing lag to hold share
red_flags.quote: An increase in procurement price was not fully passed on to the selling price to maintain the market share.

evasions.quote: it's more in terms of being cautious with this whole uncertain environment
We won't be taking price hikes per se
